label: copy phase: l/y input, about to output y (late positions)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input is l or y (99.9% of activation mass). The strongest activations are when the input is l or y and the token being output is y, i.e. the model is copying the bigram l y or y y; the top examples are all l -> y. It is also mostly limited to later recall positions (recall_idx >= 3, steps 11-17). That case has precision about 0.87 and holds about 75% of the mass. It also fires weakly, at a low rate, on l/y inputs whose next output is something else (l l, l k, l b, ...). These weak hits are about half of the active steps but only about 25% of the mass, so recall by count is about 0.5. It is silent in the original and delimiter phases, on first occurrences of a token, and on l/y inputs at early recall positions (0-2), even when the output is y.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=l (+7.20), phase=2 & in_tok=y (+6.92), phase=2 & out_tok=y (+3.96), next_out=y (+3.81), in_tok=l (+3.66), in_tok=y (+3.48). Lower it: prev_tok=<DEL> (-4.27), recall_idx=1 (-4.27), recall_idx=2 (-3.53), prev2_tok=<DEL> (-3.53).
